1. install manifest mikroscope/b.manifest.txt
   check   :put [:len [/file/find name="mikroscope/b.manifest.txt"]]
   create  :local m "mikroscope-manifest=1\nname=b\ntag=mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)\ndisk=\nveth=veth-b\nsubnet=172.30.11.0/30\nport=9200\niface-list=LAN\naddr-list=LANs\nexpose=\ncontainer-name=b\nremote-image=registry-1.docker.io/jmrplens/mikroscope-agent:1.3.1\ntoken=no\ndir=mikroscope\nfile=mikroscope/b.manifest.txt\nobject=/interface/veth name=veth-b\nobject=/ip/address interface=veth-b\nobject=/interface/list/member interface=veth-b list=LAN\nobject=/ip/firewall/address-list list=LANs address=172.30.11.0/30\nobject=/container/envs list=b-env\nobject=/container interface=veth-b\ndir=mikroscope/b\n"; :if ([:len [/file/find name="mikroscope/b.manifest.txt"]] > 0) do={ /file/set [find name="mikroscope/b.manifest.txt"] contents=$m } else={ /file/add name="mikroscope/b.manifest.txt" contents=$m }
   owned   :if ([:len [/file/find name="mikroscope/b.manifest.txt"]] > 0) do={ :if ([:typeof [:find [/file/get [find name="mikroscope/b.manifest.txt"] contents] "\ntag=mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)\n"]] = "num") do={ :put 1 } else={ :put 0 } } else={ :put 0 }
   present :if ([:len [/file/find name="mikroscope/b.manifest.txt"]] > 0) do={ :if ([/file/get [find name="mikroscope/b.manifest.txt"] contents] = "mikroscope-manifest=1\nname=b\ntag=mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)\ndisk=\nveth=veth-b\nsubnet=172.30.11.0/30\nport=9200\niface-list=LAN\naddr-list=LANs\nexpose=\ncontainer-name=b\nremote-image=registry-1.docker.io/jmrplens/mikroscope-agent:1.3.1\ntoken=no\ndir=mikroscope\nfile=mikroscope/b.manifest.txt\nobject=/interface/veth name=veth-b\nobject=/ip/address interface=veth-b\nobject=/interface/list/member interface=veth-b list=LAN\nobject=/ip/firewall/address-list list=LANs address=172.30.11.0/30\nobject=/container/envs list=b-env\nobject=/container interface=veth-b\ndir=mikroscope/b\n") do={ :put 1 } else={ :put 0 } } else={ :put 0 }
   remove  :if (([:len [/ip/firewall/address-list/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] + [:len [/interface/list/member/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] + [:len [/ip/firewall/nat/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] + [:len [/ip/firewall/filter/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] + [:len [/ip/firewall/raw/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] + [:len [/ip/firewall/mangle/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] + [:len [/ip/route/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] + [:len [/container/mounts/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] + [:len [/ip/address/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] + [:len [/interface/veth/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] + [:len [/interface/list/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] + [:len [/disk/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] + [:len [/container/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] + [:len [/container/envs/find list="b-env" key="MIKROSCOPE_TAG" value="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]]) > 0) do={ :error "mikroscope: objects tagged mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope) remain, so mikroscope/b.manifest.txt stays" }; :if ([:len [/file/find name="mikroscope/b.manifest.txt"]] > 0) do={ :if ([:typeof [:find [/file/get [find name="mikroscope/b.manifest.txt"] contents] "\ntag=mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)\n"]] = "num") do={ :if ([:len [/file/find name="mikroscope/b"]] > 0 && ([:len [/container/find root-dir="/mikroscope/b"]] + [:len [/container/find root-dir="mikroscope/b"]]) = 0) do={ :do { /file/remove [find name="mikroscope/b"] } on-error={} }; /file/remove [find name="mikroscope/b.manifest.txt"] } }; :if ([:len [/file/find name~"^mikroscope/"]] = 0) do={ /file/remove [find name="mikroscope" type="directory"] }

2. veth interface veth-b
   check   :put [:len [/interface/veth/find name="veth-b"]]
   create  /interface/veth/add name="veth-b" address=172.30.11.2/30 gateway=172.30.11.1 comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"
   owned   :put [:len [/interface/veth/find name="veth-b" comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]]
   remove  /interface/veth/remove [find name="veth-b" comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]

3. router address 172.30.11.1
   check   :put [:len [/ip/address/find interface="veth-b"]]
   create  /ip/address/add address=172.30.11.1/30 interface="veth-b" comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"
   owned   :put [:len [/ip/address/find interface="veth-b" comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]]
   remove  /ip/address/remove [find interface="veth-b" comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]

4. interface-list membership LAN
   check   :put [:len [/interface/list/member/find interface="veth-b" list="LAN"]]
   create  /interface/list/member/add list="LAN" interface="veth-b" comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"
   owned   :put [:len [/interface/list/member/find interface="veth-b" list="LAN" comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]]
   remove  /interface/list/member/remove [find interface="veth-b" list="LAN" comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]

5. address-list membership LANs
   check   :put [:len [/ip/firewall/address-list/find list="LANs" address="172.30.11.0/30"]]
   create  /ip/firewall/address-list/add list="LANs" address=172.30.11.0/30 comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"
   owned   :put [:len [/ip/firewall/address-list/find list="LANs" address="172.30.11.0/30" comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]]
   remove  /ip/firewall/address-list/remove [find list="LANs" address="172.30.11.0/30" comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]

6. container b
   check   :put ([:len [/container/find interface="veth-b"]] + [:len [/container/envs/find list="b-env"]] + [:len [/container/find name="b"]])
   create  :if ([:len [/container/envs/find list="b-env" key="MIKROSCOPE_TAG" value="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] > 0) do={ /container/envs/remove [find list="b-env"] }; /container/envs/add list="b-env" key=MIKROSCOPE_TAG value="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"; /container/envs/add list="b-env" key=RATE_HZ value="10"; /container/envs/add list="b-env" key=BUFFER_S value="60"; /container/envs/add list="b-env" key=PORT value="9200"; /container/envs/add list="b-env" key=ADDR value="172.30.11.2"; /container/envs/add list="b-env" key=MEM_LIMIT_MB value="16"; /container/envs/add list="b-env" key=CAPTURE_MB value="4"; /container/add name="b" remote-image="registry-1.docker.io/jmrplens/mikroscope-agent:1.3.1" interface="veth-b" root-dir=mikroscope/b envlist="b-env" logging=yes start-on-boot=yes restart-policy=on-failure restart-max-count=5 restart-interval=10s memory-max=64M privileged=yes ignore-remote-image-change=yes comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"; /container/start [find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]
   owned   :if ([:len [/container/envs/find list="b-env" key="MIKROSCOPE_TAG" value="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] > 0) do={ :put ([:len [/container/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] + [:len [/container/envs/find list="b-env"]]) } else={ :put [:len [/container/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] }
   present :put [:len [/container/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]]
   remove  :local had [:len [/container/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]]; :do { /container/stop [find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"] } on-error={}; :local s 0; :while (([:len [/container/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)" running]] + [:len [/container/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)" stopping]]) > 0 && $s < 30) do={ :delay 1s; :set s ($s + 1) }; /container/remove [find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]; :local i 0; :while ([:len [/container/find comment="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] > 0 && $i < 20) do={ :delay 1s; :set i ($i + 1) }; :if ($had > 0) do={ :local r 0; :while ([:len [/file/find name="mikroscope/b"]] > 0 && ([:len [/container/find root-dir="/mikroscope/b"]] + [:len [/container/find root-dir="mikroscope/b"]]) = 0 && $r < 10) do={ :delay 1s; :set r ($r + 1) }; :if ([:len [/file/find name="mikroscope/b"]] > 0 && ([:len [/container/find root-dir="/mikroscope/b"]] + [:len [/container/find root-dir="mikroscope/b"]]) = 0) do={ :do { /file/remove [find name="mikroscope/b"] } on-error={} } }; :if ([:len [/container/envs/find list="b-env" key="MIKROSCOPE_TAG" value="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"]] > 0) do={ /container/envs/remove [find list="b-env" key!="MIKROSCOPE_TAG"]; /container/envs/remove [/container/envs/find list="b-env" key="MIKROSCOPE_TAG" value="mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)"] }

removal listing:
  5 router object(s) tagged "mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)":
    container b
    address-list membership LANs
    interface-list membership LAN
    router address 172.30.11.1
    veth interface veth-b
  then any other object tagged "mikroscope:b (managed by mikroscope)", in /ip/firewall/address-list, /interface/list/member, /ip/firewall/nat, /ip/firewall/filter, /ip/firewall/raw, /ip/firewall/mangle, /ip/route, /container/mounts, /ip/address, /interface/veth, /interface/list, /disk
  and last the install manifest mikroscope/b.manifest.txt with mikroscope/b, and mikroscope when nothing else is in it
  (the manifest on the router, when there is one, says which objects the plan holds)
